d: Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates an exceptional portfolio of 31 properties, including 33 signature F&B restaurants, across the Middle East, Europe, Asia and Africa. In 1999, Jumeirah changed the face of luxury hospitality with the opening of the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab and the brand is now renowned worldwide for its distinguished beachfront resorts, esteemed city hotels and luxury residences. From the contemporary Maldivian island paradise at Jumeirah Olhahali Island to the art-inspired Jumeirah Capri Palace in Italy and the modern twist on a British classic at Jumeirah Carlton Tower in London, the brand has become synonymous with warm and generous service and the ability to craft distinctive and purposeful experiences that bring joy to guests from across the world.

Set in a secluded cove at Bandar Jissah, between the Al Hajar Mountains and the Gulf of Oman, Jumeirah Muscat Bay invites guests to experience Muscat’s breathtaking natural beauty, where mountains meet the sea at the resort’s edge. The resort offers ocean-facing rooms and suites, as well as summerhouses and villas with private plunge pools and direct beach access. Guests can also enjoy Jumeirah’s signature Talise Spa, an SSI-certified dive centre, diverse dining options, and a dedicated Kids Club.
q: The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:
High School Diploma or Higher Education (essential); Bachelor's degree in Hospitality, Human Resources, or a related field, with Business Studies and/or Business English qualifications (desirable).
2–3 years of experience in administrative support, preferably within Human Resources or the hospitality industry.
Previous experience working in a multicultural environment, ideally within the Middle East, with a strong customer service mindset and experience supporting internal stakeholders and employees.
Excellent administrative, communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
r: An exciting opportunity has arisen for an Executive - Human Capital to join Jumeirah Muscat Bay. The main duties and responsibilities of this role are:

Employee Relations & HR Support – Serve as the primary HR contact for colleagues, providing guidance on HR policies, employment matters, employee relations, performance management, disciplinary processes, and ensuring a positive colleague experience.

HR Administration & Compliance – Prepare employment contracts, letters, certificates, and other HR documentation; maintain audit-ready employee records, manage purchase orders and office supplies, and ensure compliance with company policies and legal requirements.
Talent Management – Support end-to-end recruitment, onboarding, and offboarding processes, ensuring a smooth, timely, and engaging experience for new joiners and departing colleagues.

Learning & Development – Coordinate corporate learning initiatives, manage learning platforms such as Axonify, monitor training completion, track learning hours, and generate reports to support employee development.

Colleague Engagement & Communication – Plan and execute colleague engagement activities, recognition programs (including Spirit of Jumeirah and Colleague of the Month/Year), CSR initiatives, departmental meetings, and maintain effective communication with department heads and colleagues.

Guest Experience & Operational Excellence – Maintain accurate guest profiles, coordinate VIP arrivals and special requests, oversee guest relations activities, ensure timely delivery of VIP amenities, engage with guests to gather feedback, and support exceptional service standards while performing additional duties as required.
x: At Jumeirah, we are dedicated to fostering a workplace where all colleagues feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow. Our benefits package reflects this commitment by combining rewarding financial incentives, comprehensive healthcare, and opportunities for professional development.
Access to Learning & Development programmes and clear career pathways.
Opportunities for internal mobility within our global network.
Colleague discounts on food, beverage and hotel stays worldwide.
Locally relevant benefits as determined by the property.

d: Tekkers Football Academy, in partnership with Arsenal Football Development, is looking for a passionate, ambitious coach to join our team in Bahrain and lead our growing girls’ football programme.

You’ll head up the girls’ programme and also coach across our boys’ teams and classes. That means delivering the Arsenal Football Development philosophy to players aged 3–17 and helping develop the next generation of footballers in Bahrain.
Whether you’re experienced or ready to step up, you’ll get ongoing mentoring and development alongside an experienced international coaching team.
r: Lead, develop and grow the Tekkers girls’ football programme, including squads, fixtures and player pathways.
Coach boys’ teams and classes as part of the wider academy timetable.
Deliver engaging, high-quality sessions based on the Arsenal Football Development methodology.
Support player development through term programmes, holiday camps, festivals and tournaments.
Help with the day-to-day running and organisation of the academy.
Create a positive, safe and inspiring environment where every player can enjoy football and reach their potential.
Represent Tekkers and Arsenal Football Development professionally, on and off the pitch.
1-year rolling contract, which can be extended by mutual agreement
BD 550–600 per month, tax-free (approx. £1,150–£1,250), depending on experience
Passion for developing young players, including a commitment to growing girls’ football
Positive attitude and excellent communication skills
Able to work as part of a team
UEFA C Licence or national equivalent (e.g. FA Level 2)
Experience coaching youth football, ideally including girls’ teams
If you’re ready to lead girls’ football at an ambitious academy delivering the Arsenal Football Development programme, we’d love to hear from you.

Tekkers Football Academy was founded in 2015 and is one of the leading youth football academies in the Gulf. We coach more than 1,000 players every week across Bahrain and the Eastern Province of Saudi Arabia.

As an official partner of Arsenal Football Development, we build our programmes on world-class coaching principles. Children aged 2–18 get a fun, challenging and inspiring place to develop, both as footballers and as people.

Our mission is to create lifelong opportunities through football. We do that through elite coaching, clear player pathways, international experiences and a real passion for helping every child reach their potential.

d: Join Qiddiya to manage City Operations assets as they transition from delivery into live operations. You will coordinate readiness planning, mobilisation, training and handover evidence, identifying gaps early and helping receiving teams prepare for a controlled operational transition.
q: Degree in facilities management, engineering, construction management, asset management, operations management or a related discipline.

Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in facilities management, asset operations, operational readiness or project-to-operations transition, including at least 2 years managing or coordinating readiness, mobilisation or handover workstreams
Practical experience preparing new properties, public realm, infrastructure or mixed-use assets for operational handover, coordinating delivery teams, technical specialists and receiving operators.
Experience maintaining readiness plans, verifying evidence, tracking defects and dependencies, escalating blockers and supporting transition into live operations
Relevant recognised certification in facilities management, asset management or project management is preferred.
Training in operational readiness, commissioning and handover, or health and safety is advantageous
r: Develop asset-level readiness plans aligned with delivery milestones, phased handovers and opening dates, tracking dependencies, owners and completion evidence.
Coordinate operational design reviews covering access, maintainability, cleanability, service routes, storage and operational support needs
Confirm service boundaries, operating responsibilities and interfaces, escalating ownership gaps and unresolved dependencies.
Coordinate mobilisation of service providers, staffing, equipment, consumables, procedures and support facilities.
Track handover documentation and coordinate asset-data, CAFM workflow and planned-maintenance readiness with responsible specialists
Arrange training, operational walkthroughs, scenario-based trials and joint inspections, tracking corrective actions and closure evidence
Maintain readiness registers, risk logs and evidence packs, providing recommendations for handover and opening gates without assuming technical certification or final acceptance authority
Transfer readiness records, outstanding actions and approved interim arrangements to receiving teams, supporting initial operational stabilisation

d: Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
q: Prior experience must include significant project experience and successful project management.
Vast relevant experience in a supervisory and/or project management role including technical expertise.
Strong experience in Offshore experience on Brownfield projects.
Mandatory experience in Pre-FEED and FEED phase
Maintain HSE focus with the team to ensure OHSE requirements.
Demonstrate behavior and business practices commensurate with a culture of world’s best health, safety and environmental performance.
Demonstrate a visible and active commitment to:
healthy and safe workplaces and activities; and
continuously improve Worley health, safety and environmental performance.
Identify and report work hazards and incidents.
Able to work in diverse team.
Able to make difficult decisions and lead and manage others in changing business conditions.
Highly effective people management skills such as leadership, team, interpersonal, coaching, mentoring and supervisory skills. Must be able to build, motivate, develop and manage an effective team.

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.
r: Leads budgeting and manages project operations to the budget. Controls project staffing levels, organizational structure, and monitors project discipline structures.
Ensures project work and team activities meet all health, safety, environmental, and security requirements.
To plan, co-ordinate and manage the design, procurement, construction and commissioning of assigned projects, including taking a leadership role in the preparation of proposals.
To ensure clear agreement of client objectives and that these are met or exceeded
To achieve or better the budgeted gross margin.
Effective management of Worley/Client contract, including delivery of the budget gross margin.
Manage and monitor project performance on an ongoing basis to identify issues and opportunities early and take pre-emptive action.
Effectively manages project interfaces, including use of High Value Engineering centres.
Develop resource & financial requirements from the project plan.
Manage the design, procurement and construction activities to meet the project schedule.
Project Manager ownership of the project schedule.
Routine monitoring of the key reports and development of corrective action plans.
Monitoring and control of all cost aspects of the project to forecast costs, obtain approvals, identify trends and take action to avoid cost overruns and take advantage of opportunities.
Provide clear and focused leadership for the project team to create a vision for project success and a strategy to fit that vision.
Assess procurement process throughout the project to ensure goods meet specification, are delivered on time and are within budget.
Monitor the Construction Management function to ensure safe delivery of the project within cost and schedule objectives.
Responsible for working within the provisions and guidelines of the Quality Assurance systems.

Work with project managers/project engineers to ensure all projects are set up and executed in full compliance with all the requirements of the Worley Project Management Process (WPMP) and General Management System (EMS) using consistent approaches, Work Breakdown Structures, work methodologies and reporting systems.
Monitors the closure of all identified risks and opportunities.
Responsible for personal safety safe working practices. Understand and follow OH&S procedures
Promoting health, safety and environmental awareness.
